bio: If the thought of enjoying a pleasant meal with an idyllic view appeals to you, then this could be the place. This restaurant is located on the fifth floor of the luxury The Dolli at Acropolis hotel, a historic mansion that has been completely remodelled and boasts picture-postcard views of the Acropolis. The menu here is a combination of Mediterranean cuisine with Asian options prepared by a chef who conjures up dishes within full view of guests in the dining room. Precise and meticulously presented, his dishes are always based around top-quality seasonal ingredients. The gourmet experience is more extensive in the evening and is complemented by the extensive array of wines, including labels from leading wine estates as well as artisanal vineyards....
